outcome: A user can download the report they are looking at as CSV.

acceptance_criteria.text: The export contains every row matching the report, not one page of them.

expected_verification.assertion: an export of a 320-row report contains 320 data lines

acceptance_criteria.text: The export begins with a header row naming the columns.

expected_verification.assertion: the first line is the column header

data_impact: None beyond what the criteria state.
